**Explanation:**

**Logic : Multiply all outer numbers = Inner number **

First jar [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] 7 × 2 × 9 = 126

Similarly,

Second jar [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95ba04a93bf6cfca8785bf502822ce56735adbf89f08b8b76caf68836385350.png] 6× 5× 8 = 240 

**Hence, "240" is the correct answer.**
